thread:
deploy-bot: Canary promote failed for service=payments-api image=v2026-06-01: artifact validation failed after download: expected=sha256:1111aaaa got=sha256:1111aa00. Canary automatically held.

lucas: saw this hit during the 30m change window. CI publish reported success but the artifact fetched during promote doesn't match digest.

maya: i pulled the object from storage and verified locally; matches got=sha256:1111aa00. So index vs storage disagree. Could be a bad reupload or cache corruption on the CDN edge.

ops: checking CDN and object-store logs. There's a cache-revalidate for that key ~2s after upload and we saw a 206 partial served from edge at the same time. Possible truncated multipart edge cache.

qa: integration tests are blocked by the canary hold. Options: 1) pin to last-good v2026-05-31 to keep the window moving, 2) force-promote (unsafe), 3) block and debug. Recommend pin and triage.

release-manager: agree with pin. We can't risk serving mismatched artifacts. We'll pin service-only and open follow-ups for infra and publisher. Keep change window open for others.

deploy-bot: Usage: `deploybot pin --service payments-api --image v2026-05-31 --reason "artifact digest mismatch v2026-06-01"`

lucas: running pin now:
```bash
deploybot pin --service payments-api --image v2026-05-31 --reason "artifact digest mismatch v2026-06-01"
```

deploy-bot: Pin applied. Canary reverted to v2026-05-31; traffic restored.

ops: opened INFRA-310 to investigate CDN edge partial-serves and to flush edge cache for that key. Also adding monitoring for 206 responses during publishes.

maya: created ARTIFACT-1600 to track publisher verify-after-finalize and to add a publish-time edge-cache-bust header. Assigning to @maya and @ops.

qa: we'll rerun the integration suite against v2026-05-31 to sanity-check there are no regressions. If INFRA-310/ARTIFACT-1600 are resolved, we'll attempt a clean publish+verify in staging before reattempting canary.

release-manager: release notes updated: "Canary for payments-api (v2026-06-01) held due to artifact digest mismatch between index and storage; pinned to v2026-05-31. Remediation tickets ARTIFACT-1600 / INFRA-310 opened."

lucas: quick mitigation idea: publisher should fetch the uploaded object after finalize, verify digest, and mark index only after success. Also set cache-control/etag to avoid partial edge serves. Adding to ARTIFACT-1600.

ops: monitoring shows no wider CDN issue yet, just this key pattern during high parallel publishes. incident INC-2026-091 created if we see >3 similar failures in 5m.

release-manager: decision: pin applied; no cross-service rollback. Continue other promotes. Follow-ups assigned and will report back in ARTIFACT-1600. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
